title: Mixed Event — Awakening Beat — Episode6 Before the Grudge Match

meta.Event Outline: Kohane has steadily built up experience, including performing solo at events. An, Akito and Toya all acknowledge her efforts, but Kohane herself doesn't seem confident. An and the others try to get Kohane to believe in herself.

rows.Line: Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Kohane, your voice faded away towards the end of that last past.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh no...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your voice is usually crystal clear, but it also makes it easy to listen for mistakes. Just try to focus, like you're threading a needle.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay! Thanks, Miku!
One week later

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Are you okay, Azusawa?
You seem tired. Maybe we should take a break...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It's okay, Aoyagi. I'm fine.
Let's try that one more time!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
My throat still feels fine too.
I'll make sure to say when it does start feeling like too much.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright...
Then once more from the top!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay!
Let's do this, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (We have to win this time... We just have to...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I want to stop chasing after everyone. I want to stand proud, know that I'm capable, and move forward with them...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I want to win...!  I want to have more confidence in myself!!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, that last part was really good!
You two were in perfect sync!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! You guys harmonized and produced this really warm sound!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: W-We did?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, you did!
I was very pleasantly surprised!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Me too. You came together better than usual.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah.
It was just for a second, but so beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then let's go over it one more time! There'd be no point to it if it was just a fluke.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Alright. We should master it while we can.

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line: Okay!
The day of the event
STAY GOLDEN Venue

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Phew...
It's almost our turn.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. Morning warm-ups went well, so I gotta think we're good to go.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But STAY GOLDEN does feel much more serious compared to all those other events...

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Hey, is that Vivid BAD SQUAD?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
They really came back.
Especially after what happened last time.

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: But everybody's been saying that they're on fire lately. Their battle against Arata even ended in a draw...

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Against Arata? There's no way that's true. Oh, hey! There's EVER!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Talk about a solid team.
I gotta think they're favored to win this one too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, this is a good vibe.
Nowhere to go but up for us...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yup!
We're gonna blow them away with our performance!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's do just that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Last time we were here, I couldn't do anything and disappointed the entire audience...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (If something like that happens again today...)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Hey, didn't they have some amateur girl with them...?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Yeah, I remember her. Honesty, who was she...? You think they'll do better than they did last time?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (What do I do...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (If I keep feeling this way, the same thing will...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Um, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Yes, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Mind coming with me for a second?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Where?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane and I are gonna get a breath of fresh air outside before we go on stage. That okay with you, Akito, Toya? We'll be right back.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Just don't be late.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You got it!
Let's go, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-An, wait...!
